properties.description: The JBuddies Folding Gen 2 Kids Headphones Blue/Gray are wired on-ear headphones designed for ages 2 and up, built with a volume limit to protect young ears. They ship in a blue and gray colorway. Output is capped at 85dB, a level considered safe for extended listening by young children, so volume can't be turned up to a level that could damage hearing. The headphones fold down to a compact size for easy storage in a bag or backpack, making them practical for car rides, flights, or trips to school. The headphones connect over a standard wired cable, working with any device that has a headphone jack, phones, tablets, or in-flight entertainment systems included. The headphones weigh 95 grams and measure 6.1 inches tall, 5.71 inches long, and 2.17 inches wide. Volume is adjusted with a single button on the headphone body.
